summary.intent: Identify M4 research items that could be moved into M3, then scope and kick off planning for Phase 35 (migrate staging TEE from local Docker simulator to Phala testnet CVM).
summary.outcome: Phase 35 was added to the M3 roadmap, a feature branch was created, research was completed and committed to 35-RESEARCH.md, and the plan-phase workflow was initiated.

repo: M4 phases 23-26 (Billing, Teams, Editors, Signing) form a tight dependency chain and must stay in M4; only AWS Nitro TEE (Phase 27) was a viable M3 candidate.
The TEE worker already has a TEE_MODE=cvm code path with dynamic dstack SDK import — the primary Phase 35 work is infrastructure deployment, not code changes.
Staging TEE currently runs as a local Docker simulator (mock) on the same Docker host, not real Phala infrastructure.
Key epoch transition from simulator to CVM requires wiping ipns_republish_schedule and re-enrolling on staging because simulator uses HKDF with fixed seed while CVM uses hardware-backed derivation.

TEE worker has critically low test coverage: only 1 test file for 13 source files, with only SSRF validation tested — IPNS signing, key management, epoch rotation, auth middleware all untested (CONCERNS.md:216-221).

code.finding: Uses keyResult.asUint8Array().slice(0, 32) — SDK v0.5.7 may have changed getKey() return type to { key: Uint8Array } instead of { asUint8Array(): Uint8Array }, needs verification.
Mounts /var/run/tappd.sock (dstack OS 0.3.x legacy); current dstack OS 0.5.x uses /var/run/dstack.sock — must be updated for Phala CVM deployment.

workflow: The plan-phase workflow requires the phase directory to exist before validation — it was created manually before proceeding.
Research agent returned MEDIUM confidence due to SDK return type uncertainty and key persistence behavior needing runtime verification.
Phala Cloud's phala deploy CLI auto-detects existing CVMs by name and updates them, enabling clean CI/CD integration via PHALA_CLOUD_API_KEY secret in deploy-staging.yml.

friction: plan-phase workflow read the same workflow file repeatedly (9 times) before proceeding — likely a context/parsing issue in the orchestrator.
Phase directory didn't exist and had to be created manually before the workflow could validate the phase.
open_items: AWS Nitro TEE (originally M4 Phase 27) still needs to be formally moved into M3 as a subsequent phase after Phase 35 lands.
SDK v0.5.7 getKey() return type needs runtime verification before tee-keys.ts can be confirmed correct.
Phala Cloud free tier adequacy for staging CVM needs verification.
Key persistence across CVM updates via phala deploy (same name preserving app_id) needs runtime verification.
Production migration path for epoch key transition (simulator → CVM) needs future design — staging can wipe+re-enroll but prod cannot.
TEE worker test coverage gap (CONCERNS.md high priority): IPNS signing, key management, epoch rotation, and auth middleware all need unit tests — flagged to be addressed in Phase 35.
PLAN.md files for Phase 35 not yet created — workflow was initiated but transcript ends before planner output.
